data.name: Prasad khanderai (VC)
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Prasad khanderai (VC) has made a big mark in cricket. With 4 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 9, with an average of 4.50 and a quick strike rate of 66.67. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 1 sixes and 1 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 6.0 overs, taking 2 wickets at an economy rate of 9.50. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
